articles.title: How one office shaped the foundations of Jacobs today

articles.summary: – A survey of 600 senior energy-sector decision makers across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and Australia finds that 71% believe sufficient capital is available in their industry, yet only 29% say there is both enough capital and enough investable energy infrastructure projects. The findings, published by Jacobs in The Energy Readiness Equation, reveal a consistent global challenge: having capital is only the first step. Projects also need the right approvals, grid access, equipment and infrastructure to move forward.
articles.title: New research: 71% of energy leaders globally say capital is available, but only 29% see enough investable energy projects due to constraints and interdependencies
